name: Montmirail
summary: Napoleon turned west on Sacken's Russians and the leading brigades of Yorck's Prussians, coming back towards Montmirail; Ney and the Guard stormed the farm of Marchais, and the allies were driven north towards the Marne.

sources.label: Six Days' Campaign order of battle (Wikipedia)

toCome.name: Ricard's Division
toCome.summary: Fought for the farm of Marchais through the day, with two battalions holding the Bois de Bailly.

toCome.name: Ney's Young Guard
toCome.formation: Meunier's 1st and Curial's 2nd Young Guard Divisions
toCome.summary: Meunier's division joined the fight for Marchais; Curial's stood behind Ricard's.

toCome.name: The Old Guard
toCome.formation: Friant's 1st and Michel's 2nd Old Guard Divisions
toCome.summary: Friant's battalions attacked towards the farm of Haute-Épine, and Michel's counter-attacked when they came up in the afternoon; Michel was wounded. Two battalions of the Chasseurs à Pied under Marshal Lefebvre took L'Épine-aux-Bois.

toCome.name: Nansouty's Guard Cavalry
toCome.formation: Colbert's, Lefebvre-Desnouettes's and Laferrière's Guard Cavalry Divisions, with Guyot's squadrons
toCome.summary: Colbert's and Laferrière's divisions charged down the high road, Guyot's squadrons turned the Russian left, and the Polish lancers pushed on to Viels-Maisons.

toCome.name: Defrance's Gardes d'Honneur
toCome.summary: Charged west of the ravine, cutting up the Russian brigades caught there; seven of its squadrons supported Friant's right.

toCome.name: Sacken's Corps
toCome.formation: Shcherbatov's VI and Lieven's XI Infantry Corps, Army of Silesia
toCome.summary: Some eighteen thousand men and eighty to ninety guns, marching back east to join Blücher. It took Marchais and lost it, and was driven north towards Château-Thierry.

toCome.name: Vasilchikov's Cavalry
toCome.formation: Lanskoy's 2nd Hussar and Panchulidzev's 3rd Dragoon Divisions, with Karpov's Cossacks
toCome.summary: Counter-attacked Nansouty's horse and covered Sacken's retreat.

toCome.name: Yorck's Corps
toCome.formation: Pirch's 1st and Horn's 7th Brigades, I Corps, Army of Silesia
toCome.summary: Reached Viffort late in the day. Pirch's brigade attacked the Bois de Bailly and was thrown back, Pirch wounded.
